shortTitle: AASM Adult OSA Diagnostic Testing Guideline
citation: Kapur VK, Auckley DH, Chowdhuri S, et al. Clinical practice guideline for diagnostic testing for adult obstructive sleep apnea: an American Academy of Sleep Medicine clinical practice guideline. J Clin Sleep Med. 2017;13(3):479-504.
currencyNote: The 2017 guideline remains listed as the active adult OSA diagnostic-testing guideline in the 2026-08-08 authority audit. AASM has also listed a focused update project as in development; re-verify before production release and before relying on version-sensitive patient-selection details if a newer focused update is published.
bestFor: Adult OSA diagnostic-testing pathway, clinical context for PSG versus HSAT selection, technically adequate HSAT concepts, and escalation after negative, inconclusive, or technically inadequate HSAT.

mappingRationale.D1A: Supports clinical assessment context for selecting an appropriate adult OSA diagnostic pathway.
mappingRationale.D2A: Supports preparation decisions that differ between attended PSG and HSAT while technical execution comes from current AAST/AASM sources.
mappingRationale.D2B: Provides the clinical diagnostic-testing framework governing procedure selection and follow-up.

authorityBoundary: Use for adult OSA diagnostic test selection. AAST HSAT guidance controls technologist HSAT workflow and the current AASM Scoring Manual controls scoring/technical rules where applicable.
copyrightUse: Use citation, high-level recommendation topics, original summaries, and learning objectives. Do not reproduce substantial recommendation text, evidence tables, or protected material.
